title: VENUSREM — Trade Brief · 03 Jun 2026
catalyst: Q4 FY26 delivered record ₹259 Cr revenue with EBITDA margin leaping to 24.4% (+~960 bps YoY) and PAT up 126%, debt-free and cash-rich — re-rating the stock to an all-time high; the swing question is whether this new margin base holds into Q1 FY27 or the parabolic +204% one-year run mean-reverts.
